shortDescription: Module for setup of SSLProfile Avi RESTful Object

options.name: accepted_ciphers
options.description: Ciphers suites represented as defined by https //www.openssl.org/docs/man1.1.1/man1/ciphers.html. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as AES:3DES:RC4.

options.name: accepted_versions
options.description: Set of versions accepted by the server. Minimum of 1 items required. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: allow_legacy_renegotiation
options.description: Allow backend servers to use legacy renegotiation. Field introduced in 31.2.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as False.

options.name: api_context
options.description: Avi API context that includes current session ID and CSRF Token. This allows user to perform single login and re-use the session.

options.name: api_version
options.description: Avi API version of to use for Avi API and objects.

options.name: avi_api_patch_op
options.description: Patch operation to use when using avi_api_update_method as patch.

options.name: avi_api_update_method
options.description: Default method for object update is HTTP PUT. Setting to patch will override that behavior to use HTTP PATCH.

options.name: avi_credentials
options.description: Avi Credentials dictionary which can be used in lieu of enumerating Avi Controller login details.

options.name: avi_deactivate_session_cache_as_fact
options.displayName: Avi Deactivate Session Cache As Fact
options.description: It disables avi session information to be cached as a fact.

options.name: avi_patch_path
options.description: Patch path to use when using avi_api_update_method as patch.

options.name: avi_patch_value
options.description: Patch value to use when using avi_api_update_method as patch.

options.name: cipher_enums
options.description: Enum options - TLS_ECDHE_ECDSA_WITH_AES_128_GCM_SHA256, TLS_ECDHE_ECDSA_WITH_AES_256_GCM_SHA384, TLS_ECDHE_RSA_WITH_AES_128_GCM_SHA256, TLS_ECDHE_RSA_WITH_AES_256_GCM_SHA384, TLS_ECDHE_ECDSA_WITH_AES_128_CBC_SHA256, TLS_ECDHE_ECDSA_WITH_AES_256_CBC_SHA384, TLS_ECDHE_RSA_WITH_AES_128_CBC_SHA256, TLS_ECDHE_RSA_WITH_AES_256_CBC_SHA384, TLS_RSA_WITH_AES_128_GCM_SHA256, TLS_RSA_WITH_AES_256_GCM_SHA384, TLS_RSA_WITH_AES_128_CBC_SHA256, TLS_RSA_WITH_AES_256_CBC_SHA256, TLS_ECDHE_ECDSA_WITH_AES_128_CBC_

options.name: ciphersuites
options.description: Tls 1.3 ciphers suites represented as defined by u(https //www.openssl.org/docs/man1.1.1/man1/ciphers.html). Field introduced in 20.1.7. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition. Special default for essentials edition is tls_aes_256_gcm_sha384-tls_aes_128_gcm_sha256, basic edition is tls_aes_256_gcm_sha384-tls_aes_128_gcm_sha256, enterprise edition is tls_aes_256_gcm_sha384-tls_chacha20_poly1305_sha256-tls_aes_128_gcm_sha256. Default value w

options.name: configpb_attributes
options.description: Protobuf versioning for config pbs. Field introduced in 21.1.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: controller
options.description: IP address or hostname of the controller. The default value is the environment variable C(AVI_CONTROLLER).

options.name: description
options.description: Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: dhparam
options.description: Dh parameters used in ssl. At this time, it is not configurable and is set to 2048 bits. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: ec_named_curve
options.description: Elliptic curve cryptography namedcurves (tls supported groups)represented as defined by rfc 8422-section 5.1.1 and https //docs.openssl.org/master/man3/ssl_ctx_set1_curves/. Field introduced in 21.1.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as auto.

options.name: enable_early_data
options.description: Enable early data processing for tls1.3 connections. Field introduced in 20.1.7. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition. Allowed in essentials (allowed values- false), basic (allowed values- false) edition. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as False.

options.name: enable_ssl_session_reuse
options.description: Enable ssl session re-use. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as True.

options.name: is_federated
options.description: It specifies whether the object has to be replicated to the gslb followers. Field introduced in 22.1.3. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as False.

options.name: markers
options.description: List of labels to be used for granular rbac. Field introduced in 20.1.5. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: name
options.description: Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: password
options.description: Password of Avi user in Avi controller. The default value is the environment variable C(AVI_PASSWORD).

options.name: prefer_client_cipher_ordering
options.description: Prefer the ssl cipher ordering presented by the client during the ssl handshake over the one specified in the ssl profile. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as False.

options.name: send_close_notify
options.description: Send close notify alert message for a clean shutdown of the ssl connection. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as True.

options.name: signature_algorithm
options.description: Signature algorithms represented as defined by rfc5246-section 7.4.1.4.1 and https //docs.openssl.org/master/man3/ssl_ctx_set1_sigalgs/. Field introduced in 21.1.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as auto.

options.name: ssl_rating
options.description: Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: ssl_session_timeout
options.description: The amount of time in seconds before an ssl session expires. Unit is sec. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as 86400.

options.name: state
options.description: The state that should be applied on the entity.

options.name: tags
options.description: Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: tenant
options.description: Name of tenant used for all Avi API calls and context of object.

options.name: tenant_ref
options.description: It is a reference to an object of type tenant. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: tenant_uuid
options.description: UUID of tenant used for all Avi API calls and context of object.

options.name: type
options.description: Ssl profile type. Enum options - SSL_PROFILE_TYPE_APPLICATION, SSL_PROFILE_TYPE_SYSTEM. Field introduced in 17.2.8. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as SSL_PROFILE_TYPE_APPLICATION.

options.name: url
options.description: Avi controller URL of the object.

options.name: username
options.description: Username used for accessing Avi controller. The default value is the environment variable C(AVI_USERNAME).

options.name: uuid
options.description: Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.
